title: Heartform Terror: Wolf (Viconia) (Condition)
html:
This article is about the stronger polymorph form applied to Viconia. For the weaker version applied to Sharran Novices, see Heartform Terror: Wolf (Condition).

Heartform Terror: Wolf

  • This Sharran knows your fears and has twisted its form into one of them.
